title: Introducing the All-New Spyglass Tool
summary: We are thrilled to officially launch the powerful Spyglass tool, moving it from beta to general availability to provide everyone with enhanced capabilities.

title: Enhanced Media Management in Editor
summary: Effortlessly manage your media with enhanced in-editor file controls, giving you the power to upload, organize, and customize how your images and documents appear.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a new public roadmap page, giving you full transparency into our past achievements, current progress, and future plans.

title: Elevated Checkbox Experience
summary: Our new and improved checkboxes are now bigger, easier to drag, and beautifully integrated into our modern interface, making task management effortless.

title: Smoother Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've upgraded your overall collaboration experience to bring more awareness and ease when working with others.

title: Seamless Sharing and Discovery
summary: Collaborate effortlessly and discover shared ideas and quests with ease, as we've significantly boosted the visibility and accessibility of all your shared content.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We're thrilled to make Noeko accessible to a global audience by introducing support for a wide array of international languages.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: We are excited to announce that Noeko's codebase will be open-sourced, empowering our users with greater control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the project's future.

title: Intelligent Knowledge Map
summary: Uncover deeper connections and streamline your workflow by transforming your Constellation view into a dynamic knowledge exploration hub with powerful new filtering and sharing capabilities.

title: Advanced Search Filters & Saved Views
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint information by applying advanced filters, sorting options, and saving your customized search views for instant access.

title: Smarter Note Connections
summary: Experience a more intuitive and flexible way to structure your notes, with dynamic display options that bring your interconnected ideas to life.

title: Introducing Noeko: Self-Hosted Control & Enhanced Features
summary: Experience the full power of Noeko with new options for secure self-hosting and access to premium features tailored for growing teams.

title: Polish Existing Themes & Add More
summary: We are enhancing our current themes and introducing a vibrant collection of new options to elevate your visual experience and personalize your workspace.

title: Precise Time-Aware Welcome
summary: Get ready for a more intuitive and accurate welcome message on your homepage that always reflects the correct time of day.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Introducing powerful new actions directly within your tag views, allowing you to efficiently manage and organize multiple items with ease.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly expand your content library by seamlessly integrating diverse sources like YouTube videos, websites, and text, allowing you to centralize and interact with all your essential information directly within the platform.
